title: 낙동강수계관리위원회규정 / queue:ADDENDUM:34550:20240604:00010:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Enforcement Decree of the Special Act on the Establishment of Gangwon Special Self-Governing Province and the Creation of a Global City for Future Industries) <Presidential Decree No. 34550, June 4, 2024>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on June 8, 2024.
Articles 2 through 4 Omitted.
Article 5 (Amendment of Other Statutes) (1) and (2) Omitted.
(3) Part of the Regulations on the Nakdong River Basin Management Committee shall be amended as follows:
In Article 4 (2) 1, "Governor of Gangwon-do" shall be replaced with "Governor of Gangwon Special Self-Governing Province."
In Article 6 (3) 4, "Gangwon-do" shall be replaced with "Gangwon Special Self-Governing Province."
(4) through (44) Omitted.
